decision: Accept two byte-identical frozen-original runs and the retained v0.30 installed adapter before production implementation. Preserve all original defect observations; intentional namespace correction is separately specified.
scope: 57 courses / 292 transitions covering persistent bank identity/rebinding/decay, contextual support modifiers, native clock and publication ordering, five gauge sources, sheet replacement and six namespace diagnostics.
correctionsBeforeAcceptance: The first draft called a nonexistent addStatus method; the final native interruption course uses Actor.applyStatus. No original source changed.
Simulation types required the explicit channel move policy and a concrete retained-bank record type. The final authored variant specifies move: normal.
The private gatherReleasable method had already been extracted from the retained adapter. The common public canUse query replaces it, with below/exact/above cooldown-release threshold courses.

A synthetic skill lacked the channel tag required by Stillwater. The inactive course is retained and explicitly named; a separate tagged course verifies native zero-decay and restoration after unsocketing.
The native brimFill stat clamps above zero. The course now records its minimum-rate behavior without claiming an empty held bank at the later decay phase.
All draft observations remain private evidence. These are the first accepted fixtures, not revisions of a prior expected result.
limitations: Seeded records and synthetic authored variants are explicit setup; only named native courses claim native admission and earned fill.
The six diagnostic courses retain the original stale namespace behavior. A separately specified oracle must verify the intentional correction.
No production implementation, sink failure/reentry policy, performance, renderer, hardware or native-package acceptance is established by this baseline.
